bio: Between Port Esportiu and Platja del Coco, on the third floor of the Marina Badalona hotel, you will find an open-plan restaurant dominated by white tones and offering beautiful panoramic views of the sea. From the kitchen, visible to diners and with a chef's table if you want to marvel in the cooking process, they offer a contemporary menu that is very much about mixing ingredients and experimentation, generally with rather good results. If you prefer to let your dishes be selected for you, they also offer two tasting menus: Origen and Sensaciones....
